evidence.name: Canvas: Deploy Web
evidence.userNeed: Publish from the canvas: Deploy Web creates or reuses the web placement for the version you are looking at, then shows the live URL to verify.

sections.title: Publish the version you are looking at
sections.description: Deploy Web opens the web placement flow for the funnel version currently on the canvas. Pick an existing placement to republish, or create a new one with its own alias — the placement is created and published in one step.

sections.title: Verify the live URL
sections.description: When publishing finishes the dialog shows the cloud URL (your custom domain when one is active). Open it once to confirm the first screen loads before sending traffic.
